rule_1_trendline_continuation.condition: HTF Bullish Continuation + MTF Higher Swing Low Trendline

rule_2_key_zone_continuation.condition: HTF Bullish Continuation + MTF Discount Key Zone (OB/FVG)

rule_3_pullback_ote_filter.condition: HTF Pullback Phase + MTF 61.8%-78.6% OTE Retracement

rule_4_chop_and_countertrend_filter.condition: HTF Range / Consolidation OR MTF Counter-Trend Displacement

rule_5_target_distance_floor.condition: HTF Structural Key Zone Distance < 4.0 * Risk Distance
